title: Give My Regards to Broadway

evidence.note: Written by George M. Cohan and published in 1904 by F. A. Mills; introduced in Cohan's musical Little Johnny Jones (1904).
Quotes the original sheet music as 'published by F.A. Mills (NY) in 1904,' confirming the publication year.

famous_use: Yankee Doodle Dandy (1942), James Cagney's Oscar-winning song-and-dance performance as George M. Cohan.
